value.rationale: TTC is the canonical strict-preference housing-market mechanism, and prior random-TTC research treats round assignment counts as a structural object. Three agents are the first market size supporting a genuine three-cycle and nontrivial multi-round branching. The complete chronology is therefore a natural smallest-market calibration, while the exact trade-volume probabilities quantify the economically meaningful frequency and size of actual exchanges independently of cycle-execution order.
